pkgmetadata.longdescription: Upstream binary build of the Keybase client, repackaged from the official Debian package. Unlike app-crypt/keybase it also ships the Electron GUI, which cannot be built from source without network access during the build.

use.flag: Install kbfsfuse, git-remote-keybase and the KBFS redirector
Install the kbnm native messaging host for browser integration
